rationale: The workflow already implements the supported optimizations, so no additional change is warranted. All Rust jobs restore Swatinem/rust-cache@v2, which caches the cargo registry/git checkouts and build artifacts, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is contraindicated by its "An equivalent cache already exists" condition. Every job already sets timeout-minutes (lint 30, build-tests 45, test 30, feature-contracts 60, doctests 30, benches 30, benchmark-feature 30), satisfying P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT. The concurrency block cancels in-progress runs for pull_request events, satisfying P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (same workflow/branch-or-PR supersession). The test job runs pre-built nextest archives (no compilation, no cache needed) and its npm ci already uses setup-node cache. Adding another dependency cache would be redundant, and no other supported pattern applies without unrelated or coverage-reducing changes.
